validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/CLASSIFICATION: high confidence. Urengoy-Center 2 is independently confirmed real by (1) Gazprom Transgaz Kazan's branch page, which lists 'Уренгой-Центр 2' by name alongside Center 1 among currently-operated trunk lines, and (2) Seligman's thesis, which gives an exact February-1985 completion date matching StartYear1=1985 precisely, and separately documents 1995 internal ultrasound diagnostics performed on 'Urengoy-Centre string 1' by the German firm Pipetronix within Tyumentransgaz's Krasnoturinskoye/Lyalinskoye LPUs -- further, independent operational corroboration (albeit for the sibling string, same twin-pipeline project) well after construction. DUPLICATE/ATTRIBUTION: correctly modeled as the second of two explicitly parallel strings (see P3507's validity record); not a duplicate of P3507. SPEC: P5612's recorded Diameter=1400.00mm differs from sibling P3507's 1420.00mm; per the established Ду(DN)/OD convention for this exact pipe class (confirmed via P0756 in this batch: 'Условный диаметр... 1400 мм' vs '1420 мм' outer diameter for the SAME physical pipe) and Seligman's statement that both Center 1 and 2 share a 1420mm-diameter spec, this most likely reflects an inconsistent naming convention applied by different past researchers to the two sibling rows (one nominal, one outer), not two genuinely different pipe diameters. Not corrected on the sheet; flagged here for awareness since a future researcher reconciling the family should pick one convention consistently.
